changelog: Dev build v839 - added: the Show Zoom Buttons toggle is a real function again. Its zoom +/- controls were already implemented but nothing ever injected them, while the row claimed to be unavailable; the player pass now reconciles them (inject when ON, remove exactly the two CSM-owned buttons when OFF, never duplicate on repeated passes). Fixed: the feature registry no longer reports that function as broken, the settings row is user-writable again, and the export/import action rows use the CSMKeys constants instead of duplicating string literals. Tests: 5 new zoom-button behaviour tests plus the updated honesty and player-settings contracts. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v839 - Zoom Buttons implemented; export/import keys single-sourced
